'''Kidron silk''' was a type of [[Silk/Legends|silk]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Slythor]] swapped three tons of Kidron silk in part-exchange for a badly-damaged [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]].
